title: A Space Shop storefront settings save writes only the preference keys it changes

source.ref: The residual LIVE-2347 named (settings/shop/shop-actions.ts, a whole-blob spaces.preferences writer)

detail: saveStorefrontSettingsAction (the Shop console's Storefront tab: tab label, published switch, banner image and focus) built the whole spaces.preferences object from a snapshot read at the start of the request (withStorefrontConfig) and wrote it all back with .update({ preferences }). A save there landing beside a save from another console (a Spotlight publish, a Page panel change, a menu save) could undo it. Fixed: the action now diffs withStorefrontConfig's result against the snapshot (lib/spaces/preferences-patch.ts preferencesPatch, LIVE-2347) and sends only the changed top-level keys, in practice storefront alone, through patchSpacePreferences (set_space_preferences, SCAN-833) in one call; an unchanged save sends nothing. A failed write is still not surfaced to the form, as before. No migration. Residual: other whole-blob writers remain (manage/modules/actions.ts, lib/spaces/email-style-actions.ts, lib/importer/materialize.ts, lib/library/usage.ts, and the canvas draft's revision-guarded writeSpacePreferencesAtRevision).

verify.note: Fails while settings/shop/shop-actions.ts replaces the whole preferences blob or saveStorefrontSettingsAction does not send a key-scoped patch. Behavior test: app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/shop/shop-actions.test.ts.
